data.turoyo: Annaqla haṯe, aḥ ḥəmṣani ḥəmṣe ḥewore kəmminanne, komaḥtinanne bayn i nuro. Veǧa annaqla, me d šaḥini, gmifarqʕi w koṭayro i nuraṯe, i nuraṯe koṭayro ʕal ani, d kətne yatiwe.
data.translation: Diese Kichererbsen - wir nennen sie weiße Kichererbsen - legen wir in das Feuer. Wenn sie dann heiß geworden sind, Platzen sie, und das Feuer, die kohlenglutfliegt auf die, die da sitzen.

rationale: Fills the inherited Detransitive Infectum cell with literal inanimate bursting, complementing the sole figurative human example.

summary: Keep the glossary's stem I label for quadriliteral frqʕ and its Detransitive Infectum box. Initial m- and four radicals do not authorize reclassifying it as Q.

The only inherited semantic list places sense 1 in the main I list although its example is Detransitive. New material uses that same sense key, without inventing a separately numbered Detransitive list.
waxta d- frames imminent figurative bursting in Hors2/71; g-mifarqʕi in 115/24 describes the regular outcome when chickpeas become hot. Neither requires a new aspectual box.
Is frqʕ productive outside the attested Detransitive Infectum, or should its printed active-looking base forms be treated as editorial paradigm information only? No unobserved forms are added.
The inherited human 'about to burst' use is figurative, contrasted with literal heated chickpeas bursting. The physical change occurs without an expressed external actor.
